domain: ERGON — the Learner march and the data-spine engineering
one_line: The program's engine role: marched the Learner thesis through four honest kills and one positive (residue is navigable behaviorally, not semantically), then single-handedly rescued the data spine (Postgres/DuckDB/Redis consolidation), and returned 2026-08-12 with the program's sharpest next experiment — the capacity-unconfounded Metabolization Probe.
purpose_and_thesis: Ergon owns the "Learner" — the bet that substrate failure data ("what doesn't work"), once ingested by a model, produces measurable movement toward mathematical reasoning (feedback_ergon_learner_north_star: falsification-routing — given a problem, predict which move/tool works based on mined failure). Secondary charter that grew over time: the data-spine engineering (Postgres, ingestion pipelines, the Theseus→Ergon seam, bus infrastructure).

strategic_read: Ergon is the program's most epistemically hygienic domain — every headline it produced, it then decomposed and mostly killed itself (the +0.68 → format/prior/template autopsy is a model of honest ablation), and its kill record converges on one precise sentence: the substrate stores verdicts, not derivations, so training on it yields surface classifiers; the residue's only proven handle is behavioral co-solve structure, not concepts. That means the program's founding gradient-field thesis is neither proven nor dead — it is UNTESTED AT CAPACITY, and Ergon's Metabolization Probe (REVIVAL_ASSESSMENT Move 1) is the cheapest experiment in the whole program that can settle it: C1≈C2 kills the central thesis honestly; C1>C2≈C3 gives the residue a measured price for the first time. The orchestrator should treat Move 1 as the program's critical path — it needs no new producers, no training, converges with Techne's independent pickup, and both the task set (deterministic OOD generator) and instrument-validation methodology already exist in this domain. Two cautions: (1) execution requires M1 (RTX 5060 Ti, F:/Prometheus artifacts) or pure-API runs — this box (M3) cannot train; (2) resist the resume doc's Leanstral-first ordering — the revival assessment written 41 minutes later correctly subordinates Leanstral to Move 2 (verified-trace factory) behind the probe, because building another producer before a consumer is proven is the exact consumer-drift disease Ergon's own corpus audit diagnosed (healthy producers, no consumer, 21 retired components). Also worth harvesting program-wide: Ergon's admissibility rule for frontier models (only roles where a non-model artifact falsifies the output) is the most operational piece of doctrine written since the reassessment.
